sourceRefs.locator: Wikidata Q50639077, coordinate location (P625), 48°52′17.040″N 10°13′54.120″E, used as the reference point for the cemetery. The two site plans locate Mittelhofen relative to it.

Two boards, maps labelled “Lage des alamannischen Gräberfelds im heutigen Stadtplan” and “Lage der alamannischen Siedlung im heutigen Stadtplan”. Orientation of the cemetery uphill and the farm area nearer the river; no excavation perimeter was digitised.
Opening paragraphs and excavation plan. Settlement traces, sixth to eleventh centuries, 200 metres downslope from the cemetery. Both surface buildings and sunken buildings are documented.
pp. 222–224, 231, figs. 3–4. Successive houses, few datable finds from postholes, sixth-century material and the long life of the settlement.

processingNote.de: Die Markierung bezeichnet die Flussterrasse bei Mittelhofen. Bebauung und Zäune änderten sich über Generationen.
processingNote.en: The marker identifies the river terrace at Mittelhofen. Buildings and fences changed over generations.
